biotools.summary: PhIPData defines an S4 class for phage-immunoprecipitation sequencing (PhIP-seq) experiments. Buliding upon the RangedSummarizedExperiment class, PhIPData enables users to coordinate metadata with experimental data in analyses. Additionally, PhIPData provides specialized methods to subset and identify beads-only samples, subset objects using virus aliases, and use existing peptide libraries to populate object parameters.
